en.name: Cajeta
en.summary: Cajeta is dulce de leche made with goat's milk, cooked down slowly until it is dark, pourable and intensely sweet. An unopened jar keeps about 12 months in a cool dark cupboard. Once opened it goes in the fridge, where about 3–4 weeks is a sensible working limit.
en.pantry: Unopened, keep it cool and dark; about 12 months from purchase is the guide, and the date on the jar is the real authority. Commercial cajeta is heat-processed and very high in sugar, which is what makes it shelf-stable while sealed. The goat's milk gives it a tang that deepens with age — that is character, not spoilage. Once the jar is open, the cupboard is no longer the right place.
en.fridge: Keep an opened jar covered at 4 °C (40 °F) or below and use a clean spoon every single time. About 3–4 weeks is our working figure rather than a published one: no food safety agency publishes a shelf life for cajeta, so this starts from the canned evaporated and condensed milk line and is extended because cajeta is cooked much further down and carries far more sugar per unit of water. Cajeta is looser and more pourable than most dulce de leche, so drips and double-dipping contaminate it more easily. Cajeta envinada carries a little alcohol, which helps, but not enough to make an opened jar shelf-stable.
en.freezer: There is no freezer timeline for cajeta, and freezing it is rarely worth the trouble: the sugar concentration means it never really freezes hard, and what you get back is grainier than what went in. If you have a large jar you cannot finish, the better move is to use it — over ice cream, folded into buttercream, or thinned with milk for a sauce — rather than to store it colder.
spoilage: Mould on the surface or around the rim of the jar
A fermented, yeasty or alcoholic smell in a jar that is not envinada
A lid that has domed up, or fizzing on opening
A watery layer separating out that will not stir back in
tips: Use a clean, dry spoon every time; never lick and re-dip.
Wipe the rim before closing so the lid does not glue itself shut.
Write the opening date on the lid — weeks slip past quickly on a sweet jar.
Buy the jar size you will actually finish rather than the economical one.

faq.q: Does cajeta need to be refrigerated?
faq.a: Not while sealed — about 12 months in a cool dark cupboard. Once opened, refrigerate it and use it within about 3–4 weeks.

faq.q: How long does cajeta last after opening?
faq.a: About 3–4 weeks at 4 °C or below. That is a judgement based on condensed-milk storage, not a published agency figure.
There is no timeline for it and little point. The sugar keeps it from freezing hard and it comes back grainier.

faq.q: Is cajeta the same as dulce de leche?
faq.a: Nearly. Cajeta is made with goat's milk, which gives it a tang, and it is usually looser. It stores the same way.

zh.name: 山羊奶焦糖醬
zh.summary: Cajeta 是用山羊奶熬成的焦糖牛奶醬，慢火煮到深色、可流動、甜度極高。未開封放在陰涼避光的櫥櫃大約 12 個月。開封後要冷藏，大約 3～4 週是合理的使用上限。
zh.pantry: 未開封請放陰涼避光處，從購買日起算大約 12 個月，而瓶身上的日期才是真正的依據。市售 cajeta 經過加熱處理、含糖量又極高，這就是它在密封狀態下可以常溫存放的原因。山羊奶帶來的微酸會隨時間變明顯，那是風味特色，不是腐壞。一旦開封，櫥櫃就不再是它該待的地方。
zh.fridge: 開封後請加蓋放 4 °C 以下，而且每一次都要用乾淨的湯匙。大約 3～4 週是我們判斷的使用上限，不是已發表的數字：沒有食品安全機構為 cajeta 公布保存期，所以這個數字是從「罐裝煉乳／蒸發奶」的資料出發，再因為 cajeta 熬得更乾、單位水分中的糖分高得多而往上調整。Cajeta 比多數 dulce de leche 更稀更好倒，所以更容易因為滴漏和重複沾取而受污染。加酒的 cajeta envinada 含少量酒精，有幫助，但不足以讓開封後的罐子常溫存放。
zh.freezer: Cajeta 沒有冷凍期限，冷凍通常也不划算：糖度太高，根本凍不硬，解凍後質地反而更粗。一大罐吃不完的話，更好的做法是把它用掉——淋冰淇淋、拌進奶油霜，或用牛奶調稀當醬汁——而不是把它冰得更冷。
spoilage: 非加酒款卻聞到發酵味、酵母味或酒味
蓋子鼓起，或開罐時冒氣
分離出一層水，而且攪不回去
tips: 每次都用乾淨乾燥的湯匙，不要舔過再沾。
蓋回去前先擦瓶口，免得蓋子黏死。
在蓋子上寫開封日期；甜醬的時間過得特別快。
買你真的吃得完的容量，不要只看划算。

faq.a: 未開封不用，陰涼避光的櫥櫃大約 12 個月。開封後請冷藏，並在大約 3～4 週內用完。

faq.q: Cajeta 開封後可以放多久？
faq.a: 冷藏在 4 °C 以下大約 3～4 週。這是依據煉乳保存資料所做的判斷，不是機構公布的數字。
沒有對應期限，也沒什麼意義。糖度太高凍不硬，解凍後質地更粗。

faq.q: Cajeta 和 dulce de leche 一樣嗎？
faq.a: 幾乎一樣。Cajeta 用山羊奶，帶一點微酸，質地通常也比較稀。保存方式相同。
